description:
Outpost 01 was conceptualized and brought to life through a collaborative, cross-functional team effort where every member contributed their core strengths:

Nakeisha: Integrated the NASA API and backend programming.

Aria: Handled core game mechanics and overarching programming.

Santun: Designed the 2D UI and established the overall look and feel of the game.

Francis: Integrated 3D design to visualize the lunar base and astronauts on the moon.
